subject: Velora Health — short log-hold + backup purge sync
messages:
From: Julia Steinberg <julia.steinberg@velorahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Velora <procurement@velorahealth.com>, security@velorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Velora: short notice log hold request ahead of audit

Alex —

We have an upcoming compliance window for a third-party audit that was moved up unexpectedly to the week of 2028-03-06. Our security team needs to request a short-term hold on application logs and a halted backup purge for a subset of customer identifiers (Velora Customer IDs: VEL-*/PROD) while they complete evidence collection.

Specifically: can Redwood place a temporary hold to prevent the scheduled purge of backups that would otherwise delete logs generated between 2027-11-01 and 2028-02-20 for the Velora tenant? We understand this is outside normal retention and are open to a scoped exception (limited time window).

We also need to confirm: 1) which subprocessors hold copies of the affected logs, 2) whether there's a way to provide hashed or metadata-only exports instead of raw logs to limit PII, and 3) whether Redwood can provide SOC 2 evidence (redacted) for the backup/restore and logging controls.

I copied procurement for contract/approval lane. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Julia Steinberg
Head of InfoSec Operations
Velora Health

Attachment: none
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Steinberg <julia.steinberg@velorahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Velora: short notice log hold request ahead of audit

Hi Julia — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear the audit moved earlier. We can support a scoped pause on the backup purge for the Velora tenant and coordinate a temporary hold on log deletions, but a few operational and contractual items to confirm first:

1) Scope & duration: We can stop the automated purge for affected snapshots and retain associated logs for up to 90 additional days beyond their scheduled deletion. To minimize blast radius, we recommend specifying the exact dataset prefixes (example: velora-prod-*) and the retention window you need held.

2) Subprocessors: I attached the current subprocessor snapshot (see attachments) — primary storage/backups are handled by Redwood-managed object storage and a third-party archival provider. Kimberly, can you confirm if we need to produce a formal subprocessor addendum or redline the DPA?

3) Data minimization option: We can generate a metadata-only export (timestamps, request IDs, hashed user identifiers) instead of raw logs to reduce PII exposure. Full raw logs are more sensitive and require additional controls and approval.

4) Evidence (SOC2): We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and the relevant control mapping for logging/backup processes under an NDA or via our secure evidence portal.

Proposed next steps:
- Julia/procurement: confirm exact dataset prefixes and the desired hold window (start/end).
- Redwood: prepare a 30/60/90 day hold plan and DPA addendum draft (attached: dpa-addendum-draft.docx and backup_purge_timeline_v1.xlsx).
- Kimberly/legal: review the draft addendum and confirm approval path.

If it's helpful, I can schedule a 30-min sync between Velora security, Redwood operations, and legal.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: dpa-addendum-draft.docx (draft addendum), backup_purge_timeline_v1.xlsx (proposed timeline)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Steinberg <julia.steinberg@velorahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Velora: short notice log hold request ahead of audit

Julia / Alex —

Thanks — I reviewed Alex's proposed addendum. A few clarifications I need before we can enact a retention exception:

- Exact scope language: the addendum must enumerate the customer identifiers and the backup snapshot identifiers to avoid an open-ended hold. Please provide the dataset prefixes and example snapshot IDs (Velora-prod-20271101.. etc.).
- Timebox: Redwood is comfortable with a time-limited exception (30/60/90 days). We should agree on automatic expiration and an ops playbook for releasing the hold.
- Subprocessors & cross-border transfers: we will include a subprocessor snapshot (attached) and a clause limiting exports to operational staff listed in the addendum; any transfer outside the US will require an explicit subprocessor approval.
- Evidence delivery: we can share SOC 2 Type II report excerpts and control mappings, but full raw logs containing PII cannot be exported without an executed DPA addendum and either a binding audit agreement or a court/order. Consider the metadata-only export Alex suggested as the default.

If Velora can confirm the prefixes and accept a metadata-first approach (with the option to request full logs under escalated legal review), we can issue the addendum and a DocuSign link today.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: subprocessor_snapshot_202802.pdf
From: Julia Steinberg <julia.steinberg@velorahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Procurement Velora <procurement@velorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Feb 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Velora: short notice log hold request ahead of audit

Alex / Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement confirmed they will approve a 60-day hold as a first step. Scope is: dataset prefixes velora-prod-* and velora-stage-*; snapshot window 2027-11-01 through 2028-02-20.

We prefer the metadata-only export as first-line evidence (timestamps, request IDs, hashed user ids). If our auditors require raw logs, we'll follow the escalation path you described and execute the addendum/NDAs.

Procurement contact: Mariah Cole <procurement@velorahealth.com> — please send DocuSign for the addendum and the timeline. Security will expect SOC 2 excerpts via your secure portal; I can trigger a secure file exchange once we get the addendum in place.

Can you confirm RC (Redwood ops) will not run the scheduled purge for the scoped snapshots until DocuSign is complete and the hold start date is set to 2028-02-28? We need that operational assurance in writing.

Thanks,
Julia

--
Julia Steinberg
Head of InfoSec Operations | Velora Health
julia.steinberg@velorahealth.com
